title: MechSci: Scaling Clinical Science via Mechanistic Interpretability of Medical Foundation Models

contributions.purpose: 把医学基础模型的稠密潜表征转成稀疏可解释的临床概念,以生成可检验科学假设
contributions.mechanism: 端到端自动流水线:Matryoshka Top-K 稀疏自编码器分解 3D CT 基础模型(Merlin)特征 + LLM 自动概念解释 + PheWAS 系统性关联临床结局
contributions.evaluation: 对 39 个临床结局做 PheWAS,四种 SAE 共生成 34,047 个特征-结局假设对(K=5/10/20/40 分别 6357/6942/7605/13143)
contributions.domain: 医学影像 / 机制可解释性 / 自动科学发现
contributions.source_quote: This work introduces a fully automated pipeline to uncover novel scientific knowledge by transforming the latent representations of medical foundation models into sparse, human-interpretable concepts.

contributions.purpose: 验证 Matryoshka SAE 相比标准 Top-K SAE 更优
contributions.mechanism: 比较两类 SAE 的重构保真度(R2)与下游临床任务表现的帕累托前沿
contributions.evaluation: Matryoshka SAE 在同等 alive features 下 R2 更高,下游风险模型 AUC 亦占优(帕累托改进)
contributions.source_quote: Matryoshka SAEs (orange) consistently achieve a higher coefficient of determination (R^2) for a given number of alive features compared to standard Top-K SAEs (blue), demonstrating a superior Pareto frontier and more efficient learning.

contributions.purpose: 以案例展示自动发现的新影像生物标志物
contributions.mechanism: 系统标记出 image_Concept_66(腹部脂肪异常软组织密度与条索),经 LLM 解释后在留出集评估其对未来皮肤癌的预测力
contributions.evaluation: image_Concept_66 对未来皮肤癌 OR=3.695(95%CI 2.840-4.808,p<0.001),显著超过年龄(OR 1.815)等临床风险因素
contributions.source_quote: This feature is shown to be a strong predictor for the future onset of skin cancer (cancer_skin), with an odds ratio of 3.7 (p < 0.001), significantly outperforming clinical risk factors such as patient age, sex, race and BMI and smoking status.

self_declared_provenance.quote: A key innovation in our approach is the use of Matryoshka Top-K SAEs [7]. This architecture improves upon standard SAEs by learning a nested, hierarchical set of features.
an LLM-based auto-interpretation module was implemented. Following the methodology of recent work in auto-interpretation [5]

notes: 论文自曝论文本身由 pipeline 单次(single shot, Gemini 2.5 Pro)生成。作者主动承认局限/负面:结论仅相关非因果,image_Concept_66 可能是混杂因子或检测到漏记的转移/已治疗癌症;单中心数据泛化性未验证;AutoInterp 标签仅 60% 泛化分且非绝对可靠。四元组适配良好,C1 为方法,C2/C3 为 finding。
